ys = train['yield strength (MPa)'].values
el = train['elongation (%)'].values

# Pareto front of training data (maximize both)
def is_pareto(ys, el):
    n = len(ys)
    pareto = np.ones(n, dtype=bool)
    for i in range(n):
        if not pareto[i]:
            continue
        # dominated if someone has >= both and > at least one
        better = (ys >= ys[i]) & (el >= el[i]) & ((ys > ys[i]) | (el > el[i]))
        if better.any():
            pareto[i] = False
    return pareto
